project_context.design_goal: A completely simplified, frictionless booking flow replacing complex legacy systems. Focus on minimal taps and maximum visual clarity.

theme_and_archetype.rationale: For a mobile mobility app, clarity and speed are paramount. We avoid muddy gradients and rely on stark contrast (Pitch Black on Pure White) with a high-visibility accent (Cyber Yellow) to drive action instantly.

typography.strategy: The Anti-Default. No Inter. We use a wide, bold geometric sans for headings to create an authoritative, modern feel, paired with a highly legible technical sans for body.

spacing.philosophy: Generous touch targets (min 48px) and optical alignment. Dense grouping for related data, massive gaps between distinct sections.

layers: Layer 2: Draggable Bottom Sheet (Drawer) containing the UI flow.
Layer 3: Sticky bottom safe-area container for the main CTA.
layout_strategy.grid_system: Bento-style for vehicle selection. grid-cols-2 with the primary vehicle taking full width, alternatives below.

Map_View.styling: absolute inset-0 z-0 bg-zinc-200. Use a minimalist map style to avoid visual noise.

Bottom_Sheet_Drawer.description: The command center. Houses all inputs and selections.
Bottom_Sheet_Drawer.styling: absolute bottom-0 w-full bg-white rounded-t-[32px] shadow-[0_-8px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] z-10 transition-all duration-300

Location_Timeline_Input.description: Replaces standard box inputs with a vertical 'timeline' layout to save vertical space.
Location_Timeline_Input.styling: Flex column with a left-side visual connector (black dot -> grey line -> black square). Two rows of text: 'Current Location' and a subtle 'Where to?' trigger.
Location_Timeline_Input.interaction: Tapping 'Where to?' expands the sheet and focuses a real input field.

Quick_Destinations_Row.description: Horizontal scrolling row (Schnellziele) right below the location input.
Quick_Destinations_Row.item_styling: flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 rounded-full whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-semibold transition-colors

Address_Search_Expanded.description: The view when searching for an address.
Address_Search_Expanded.styling: Large, bold text input without visible borders (border-b-2 focus:border-black). List of autocomplete results below with 'MapPin' icons.

Vehicle_Selection_List.description: Horizontal swiper or Bento grid for cars.
Vehicle_Selection_List.card_active: border-2 border-black bg-white shadow-md p-4 rounded-2xl w-[140px] flex-shrink-0 relative
Vehicle_Selection_List.card_inactive: border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 p-4 rounded-2xl w-[140px] flex-shrink-0 opacity-70 transition-opacity hover:opacity-100

Booking_CTA.description: The primary action. Massive and undeniable.
Booking_CTA.styling: w-full bg-[#FFD600] text-black font-black text-lg h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-[#FFD600]/20 mt-4 mb-safe

Booking_Status_View.description: Post-booking confirmation replacing the booking form.
Booking_Status_View.styling: Flex col, centered. Huge ETA (e.g., '3 min'). Driver avatar, Vehicle license plate in a stark black badge. Ghost button for 'Cancel'.

motion_and_interaction.sheet_snap: Use Framer Motion spring physics (stiffness 300, damping 30) for drawer snapping.
motion_and_interaction.skeleton_loading: Use pulse animation (bg-zinc-200) for ETA and price before fully loaded.

icons_and_media.style: Weight: Bold or Duotone for contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use React (.js) and Tailwind CSS.
Do NOT use HTML `<input>` directly for the main interaction; trigger a Shadcn UI Drawer that opens to 90% height for address entry.
Apply 'pb-safe' or equivalent margin to account for mobile safe areas on the Booking CTA.
The vehicle cards must visually swap styles dynamically based on the selected state (black borders vs grey borders).
Ensure all components map to the exact `data-testid` specified above.
Map background should be absolute, with the Drawer overlaid on top using z-index.
